d: Bihar ke darbhanga jile se ek haee-prophail jamin vivad ka mamla samne aaya hai, jahan alingar (bhajpa) vidhayak maithili thakur ke pita ramesh thakur par graminon ne ganbhir aarop lagae hain. mamla tardih prakhand ki pokharbhinda panchayat ka hai, jahan sarkari jamin, sarvajnik raste, samuhik shraddhasthal aur niji bhukhandon par atikraman ke davon ko lekar tanav vyapt hai.
